newsitem.title: UK: BA sets 6p kg cargo surcharge, 3p for Europe.
newsitem.headline: BA sets 6p kg cargo surcharge, 3p for Europe.

text.p: British Airways Plc's division World Cargo is applying a six pence per kg cargo fuel surcharge on intercontinental freight from November 8, a BA spokeswoman said.
The surcharge for freight on European and UK routes is smaller at three pence a kg, she added.
"Operational costs including fuel have increased dramatically in the past few months. BA is unable to continue absorbing this increase," she said.
Since last Friday other major European carriers including Lufthansa Cargo, KLM Royal Dutch Airlines, Air France have all announced surcharges.
Swissair has announced a rate increase to cover the sharp rise in jet fuel costs over recent months.
